note: Seconds per test of the default-feature workspace library tests on GitHub's hosted runners, used only to balance the parts of rust-workspace-lib-parts. Measured on the four part jobs per system of one run (four test threads; each test timed from its start in libtest's name-order schedule to its result line, rust_workspace_lib_plan.seconds_from_log on each part's log, the parts' times merged). rust_workspace_lib_plan.py LOG --system S --source TEXT refreshes a system from one log of the unsplit run. Tests under one second are not named; a test the table does not name weighs its system's other, the mean of those.
